description: logos hooks. PreToolUse on Bash/PowerShell: prod-guard blocks any command that touches the Logos prod stand (docker-compose.prod.yml, compose project logos-prod, compose down -v, docker volume rm/prune; deliberate bypass: LOGOS_PROD_OK=1 in the command); vault-guard blocks git write commands (add, commit, push, stash, reset, checkout, ...) whose effective directory is the Obsidian vault, which obsidian-git commits on its own. PostToolUse on Edit/Write/MultiEdit: doctrine-guard reports, for a file under gateway/app, gateway/tests or web/src of the Logos code repo, lines that carry phase history / narrative (a `spec:` pointer is the only allowed phase reference) and app/web modules over 1000 lines, so the coder fixes them at once. Every script fails open: garbage input, another repository or an internal error never blocks.
